malaysian.diploma_pathway: Diploma in relevant field with CGPA 2.0

requirements.general_text: STPM Pass with a minimum Grade C (GPA 2.00) in any two (2) subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. A-Level Pass with a minimum Grade D in any two (2) subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. UEC Pass with at least Grade B in any five (5) subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. STAM Pass with a minimum Grade Jayyid in any two (2) subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. Foundation / Matriculation Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. Diploma in Computing Fields (Level 4, MQF) or Equivalent Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.50. Candidates with a CGPA below 2.50 may need to undergo an internal interview. Diploma in Non-Computing Fields (Level 4, MQF) or Equivalent Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.75 and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. Candidates with a CGPA below 2.75 but more than 2.50 may need to undergo an internal interview. Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (DKM) / Diploma Vokasional Malaysia (DVM) / Diploma Lanjutan Kemahiran Malaysia (DLKM) in Computing Fields Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.50. English Language Requirements (for International Students) MUET: Minimum 3.5 IELTS: Minimum 5.0 TOEFL: Ess Online: Minimum 7.5 iBT: Minimum 40 Pearson: Minimum 47 Linguaskill OL: Minimum 154 ELS: Minimum 107 Exemptions: International students with qualifications from educational systems where English is the main medium of instruction are exempt from this requirement. Additional Option: International students who do not fulfill the English Language Requirements may join the Intensive English Programme at Nilai University, which builds their skills and prepares them for the IELTS examination.
